title: Ginger crab and sweetcorn broth
summary: A Chinese-style crab and sweetcorn soup with rice noodles, thickened slightly with cornflour and finished with egg ribbons and spring onion.

steps.instruction: Soak the noodles in freshly boiled water until they bend, then drain. Drain the sweetcorn. Stir the stock into the water. Mix the cornflour with 3 tablespoons of cold water. Beat the egg.
Simmer the ginger in the stock for 5 minutes, then add the sweetcorn and tamari.
Stir the cornflour mix into the soup and simmer until it turns lightly silky.
Add the crab and noodles and heat them through. Pour in the egg in a thin stream while stirring, so it sets in ribbons.
Take the pan off the heat, add the sesame oil and spring onion, and serve.
